problem: Predictions generated on checkpoint-training identities are train-resubstitution calibration and cannot support authoritative calibration or scheduler-threshold selection.

identity_sets.calibrator_fit_identities: identities used only to fit RAW, INTERCEPT_ONLY or PLATT parameters
identity_sets.policy_selection_identities: identities used only to select the three scheduler thresholds
identity_sets.heldout_evaluation_identities: identities used only for final L3 metrics
identity_sets.checkpoint_training_identities: identities used to train the checkpoint that generated the predictions

required_separation: calibrator_fit ∩ checkpoint_training = empty unless genuine OOF provenance is proven
policy_selection ∩ checkpoint_training = empty unless genuine OOF provenance is proven

A_nested_group_holdout_with_retraining.description: Freeze fit, policy and heldout identity roles first, then train checkpoints excluding fit and policy identities.

B_group_cross_fitted_OOF.description: Generate fit and policy predictions only from checkpoints that did not train on the predicted identities.

C_independent_calibration_identities.description: Pre-register identities never used in checkpoint training and divide them into fit and policy roles.

D_project_frozen_equivalent.description: Alternative design with equivalent identity separation and checkpoint-exclusion guarantees.

calibration_fit: canonical episode, step and probability fields
policy_selection: sealed runtime, evaluation and calibration roots
policy identities exactly match runtime episodes
policy disjoint from fit and checkpoint training
